items.docs: Retrieve exchange rate data representing fiat currency equivalents per cryptocurrency unit. Returns rates for all supported cryptocurrency and fiat currency pairs.

info.name: Get Exchange Rates for a Base Currency

params.name: baseCurrency
params.description: The base cryptocurrency code (e.g., BTC, ETH).

items.docs: Retrieve exchange rates for a specific base cryptocurrency against all supported fiat currencies.

info.name: Get Exchange Rate for Currency Pair

params.name: quoteCurrency
params.description: The quote fiat currency code (e.g., USD).

items.docs: Retrieve the exchange rate for a specific cryptocurrency/fiat currency pair.
